_meta.purpose: B-U8/R12: the DECLARED producer -> topic -> consumer matrix plus the capture-control credential and carve-scope contracts. This is the contract to verify real service/ACL config against (not an auto-derived scan); a route or credential that does not match it is a bug.

topics.note: requires the route.lua modbus route (B-U8); previously Modbus fell through to suricata.raw.v1 and ot-detectors never fired

capture_control_credential.requirement: capture-agent must NOT reuse the produce-only telemetry shipper credential (which is write-only under the telemetry prefix, per deploy/central/redpanda/entrypoint.sh). It needs a dedicated least-privilege capture credential.

carve_scope_disclosure.requirement: when no BPF applies or the carve is empty, capture-agent may upload the broad shared capture window. The resulting finding MUST disclose broad-window scope (never labelled isolated exact-session evidence) and bound the uploaded bytes.
